row.evidence: Segment's SCIM guide is marked Business-only (Free x, Team x, Business ✓, Add-on x) and says SSO, a prerequisite for SCIM, "is only available to Business Tier customers".
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated), but the plan changed: June recorded 'Business + SSO Edition add-on'; current Segment docs mark SSO and SCIM as Business tier with no add-on, so the SSO Edition add-on is dropped (no first-party source). segment.com/pricing now redirects to twilio.com/en-us/pricing/customer-data; Connections Team starts at $120/month (10,000 MTUs, 10 seats), Business is custom. Pricing is per MTU, not per seat, so per-user fields are null. SCIM needs an SSO connection first. SCIM cannot update userName/displayName after creation; deactivate or delete removes the user from the workspace (accounts are never deleted). June's 'Twilio Console SCIM still in beta' concerns the Twilio console, not Segment, and was not re-verified.

auth.token_source: Settings > Advanced Settings > SSO Sync > Generate SSO Token
auth.notes: Entra tutorial: 'Long lived bearer token authentication supported.' Exact expiry not stated by Segment.

operations.notes: User attributes cannot be updated via SCIM; active:false and DELETE both remove the user from the workspace (no account deletion); active:true re-adds. PATCH is used for active and group membership but verbs are not listed.

deprovision.data_retained: Segment account is kept (only the user can delete it); group memberships are lost and must be reassigned on re-add.

filtering.notes: From Microsoft's Entra tutorial attribute table.

attributes.notes: Entra's mapping table also lists emails[type eq "work"].value, but Segment says only userName and displayName are supported.

roles.how: Groups created via SCIM get Minimal Workspace Access; permissions must be assigned to groups in the Segment web app.

limitations.text: userName and displayName cannot be updated via SCIM after creation.
Users cannot be deleted; deprovisioning only removes them from the workspace.
Entra needs the ?aadOptscim062020 flag on the tenant URL.
SSO connection must exist before SCIM; only workspace owners can configure SSO.

auth.notes: Workspace-scoped Public API tokens created under Settings > Access Management > Tokens.

capabilities.notes: delete_user means removing users from the workspace (DELETE /users), consistent with SCIM behaviour.

endpoints.purpose: Remove one or multiple users (60 req/min)
List user groups for a user
Replace users in user group (path as documented)
Remove users from user group (path as documented)

rate_limits.text: Limits based on IP, token and request complexity, reported via X-RateLimit headers; DELETE /users is 60 requests per minute.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SWA, SCIM and Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push/Group Linking as checked (read from page markup).

google.notes: Segment supports Google Apps For Work as an SSO connection; no Google provisioning documented. Google catalogue not checked.

onelogin.notes: From Segment's docs; OneLogin connector page not loaded (bot challenge).
